material_findings.control_gap: New ninth test replaces execute_one with lambda prepare(attempt), bypassing the actual API catch-and-serialize path. Its raw-array assertions therefore do not test this integration contract.
material_findings.effect: Previously serializable failed-policy returns now become an unrelated serialization failure even if saving partial observations succeeds. The nested original cause survives, so no false success is introduced, but the fixed API failure-payload contract is broken and outer original_case_exception can again name a secondary serialization cause.
material_findings.minimal_fix: Retain actual chunks in worker-private gate.context rather than the API preparation_prefix. Keep only ordinary JSON-safe chunk identity metadata, completed block IDs and original/secondary errors in the prefix. Verify the targeted control can feed the real failure prefix to unchanged driver encoded; optionally exercise actual execute_one with a manufactured preparation exception, which needs no native owner or optimizer dispatch.
material_findings.scope: No math, criteria, protocol, accepted-point selection or native execution change required.
material_findings.source_integration: prepare_case assigns prefix to attempt[preparation_prefix]. Unchanged matched_driver.py payload351 directly includes attempt.get(preparation_prefix), and encoded at56-57/json serialization363 has no NumPy adapter. execute_one catches the observation Exception as a failed policy payload, then raises TypeError trying to serialize this raw-array prefix.
material_findings.title: Keep failed preparation prefix JSON-safe for the unchanged API serializer
material_findings.trigger: An ordinary observation exception occurs after at least one completed batch. The new fix sets prefix[available_completed_observation_arrays] to a list of NumPy ndarrays.

original_finding.source_fix: The original observation cause is recorded before diagnostic work and secondary partial-save errors are now guarded; that narrow source behavior is fixed.
